supersedes.reason: C6.1 published the query service and corrected the stale release audit. However, its _verify_integrity() only checked digest string shape (non-empty, sha256: prefix, non-duplicate) without recomputing digests from canonical event content. A tampered ledger line retaining its original digest string would be projected as integrity_verified=True. C6.2 hardens the read-side verification boundary and adds the shared verified reader consumed by both query and operations services.

mission: C6.2 — Read-Side Canonical Integrity Verification and Provider Diagnostics Projection Hardening

c6_1_defect_documented.defect: _verify_integrity() verified digest shape, not content. load_provider_events() silently skipped malformed JSON and did not schema-validate or digest-recompute events. ProviderEvidenceQueryService accepted arbitrary dict injections as canonical evidence.
c6_1_defect_documented.impact: A tampered ledger line with preserved digest string would report integrity_verified=True in both query and operations services.
c6_1_defect_documented.c6_append_authority: NOT affected. persist_provider_event() remained fail-closed with schema validation before append. Only read-side verification was insufficient.

new_types: VerifiedLedgerResult (typed loading result with valid/corrupt separation)
shared_verified_reader.new_function: load_verified_provider_events() — schema-validates, digest-recomputes, surfaces malformed lines, detects duplicates
key_functions: _recompute_event_digest() — blanks stored digest before recomputation matching persistence rule
shared_verified_reader.deprecated: load_provider_events() retained for compatibility but marked as deprecated for authoritative consumption
